payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

condition.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
condition.criteria: Assess the jacket’s front closure itself by comparing corresponding visible portions in SOURCE and EDITED. Full achievement requires the front panels to meet along the closure with no visible opening remaining. Count partial fulfillment only where corresponding visible portions show the panels have moved together toward closure while an opening remains. Assign zero only when corresponding closure portions are sufficiently visible and show no movement of the panels toward one another relative to SOURCE. If the closure or corresponding portions are obscured, or pose and drape prevent reliable comparison, treat the observation as unresolved rather than inferring zero or progress.
condition.binding: Compare the original jacket on the woman in SOURCE with that same jacket in EDITED. Compare corresponding visible portions of the jacket closure, not the overall silhouette or how the jacket hangs. A changed pose or drape alone is not evidence of closure progress. If corresponding closure portions are not sufficiently visible for reliable comparison, use insufficient evidence.
condition.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
condition.zero_when: Corresponding portions of the closure are sufficiently visible in SOURCE and EDITED for comparison, and show no visible movement of the front panels toward one another. Do not assign zero from an open-looking silhouette, pose change, or drape; if the closure cannot be reliably compared, leave fulfillment unresolved.
condition.half_when: Corresponding visible portions show the front panels moved together toward closure, but a visible opening remains. If pose, drape, or occlusion makes panel movement indeterminate, leave fulfillment unresolved rather than assigning partial fulfillment.
condition.full_when: The jacket’s front panels meet along the visible closure, with no visible opening remaining; corresponding closure portions are sufficiently visible to establish this endpoint.
